text.en:
Item 1, subsection DD, section one of Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-eight, more
commonly known as the General Appropriation Act for the year nineteen hundred and thirty, is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"1. One Director, with quarters at Singalong Experiment Station, the provisions of Act Numbered Two
thousand five hundred eighty-nine, as amended, to the contrary notwithstanding

Item 201, subsection DD, section one of the same Act is also hereby amended to read as follows:
"201. Organization of scouting parties to locate and fight locusts, Act Numbered Three thousand one hundred
sixty-three, and to control and eradicate other agricultural pests and diseases
"201-a. For the campaign to control and eradicate the leaf miner and other coconut pests and diseases
400,000.00"

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and thirty.
Approved, August 9, 1930.
